answer: An agent economy can deter Sybils using bonded inventory staking across an attestation trellis. Participating nodes must lock cryptographically signed custody receipts for physical goods, such as cedar timber or pearl reserves, into escrow contracts. This compels attackers to expend scarce capital acquiring physical inventory per identity rather than deploying free software clones. However, this defense relies on fallible off-chain inspectors, creating centralized oracle risks.
